title: 1RB1LC_1RC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE0LD_1LF---_0RA1LA: halting is now a question about one map on numbers, in Lean
text: All proved rules form one function on records (n, m, tail), and Lean proves that the machine halts from blank tape if and only if the walk of this map from (17, 0) with 6805 words 1110 reaches a halting class. The walk is plain arithmetic, but the second level alone takes about 10<sup>771</sup> of its steps, on numbers of about 10<sup>770</sup> digits.
